1.

The petitioner has preferred the present writ petition inter alia with the following prayer :
"(a) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the Respondents Authorities to send the petitioner for necessary training on the post of Constable Civil Police, pursuant to Police Constables Direct Recruitment Examination-2023 by Notification No. PRPB -one (1)150-RFP/2023 (b) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus, directing the Respondent Authorities, to complete the formalities of character verification and Ashish Kumar Gond vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 9 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19666084/
1
Select & Appoint the petitioner finally for the post of Constable Civil Police, in pursuant to Police Constables Direct Recruitment Examination-2023 by Notification No. PRPB -one (1)150-RFP/2023.

"
2. Pursuant to the recruitment process initiated by the State Government to the post of Constable (Male and Female) in the Civil Police in the year 2023, the petitioner applied through online application as Scheduled Tribes (Male) candidate for the selection of Constable Civil Police.

The admit card was issued to the petitioner permitting him to appear in the written examinations, which was held on 23.08.2024, the petitioner participated in the aforesaid examination and found to be selected.

Subsequent to the same, the documents of the petitioner were duly verified and thereafter,
the petitioner also participated in the Physical Standard Test, which was held on 20.01.2025.
It is stated in paragraph no.12 of the petition that in the Physical Standard Test of the petitioner, the petitioner got success in thePhysical Standard Test.

Subsequently, the petitioner also duly appeared before the Medical Examination Board, which was held on 08.05.2025, during the aforesaid medical examination, petitioner submitted necessary papers and documents including the notary affidavit dated 23.04.2025 by disclosing the pendency of the criminal case against him being Case Crime No.199 of 2021 under Section 147, 323, 504, 506, 452, 419, 420 IPC, in which, after investigation, a charge sheet has been submitted against him.

3. It is argued that the petitioner was duly selected candidate and his name appeared at Serial No.46976, though the petitioner was called for police verification on 16.05.2025 but no further action was taken in the matter by the respondents only on the ground that the criminal case is pending against the petitioner.

It is stated in paragraph no.22 of the writ petition that the office staff of the respondents orally informed the petitioner that on account of the pendency of the criminal case, he was not allowed to join.

4. Counsel for the petitioner placed reliance on judgment and order of a co-ordinate Bench of this Court dated 16.05.2022 passed in Writ A No.18501 of 2021 (Aashish Kumar Vs. State of U.P. and 6 others).

entities.text: Aashish Kumar Vs. State of U.P. and 6 others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is argued that the controversy involved in the present case is almost identical as in the case of Aashish Kumar (supra).
5.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6. With the consent of the parties, the present writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent no.5 namely, Additional Commissioner of Police, Police Headquarters Commissionerate, Varanasi,
to accord consideration to the petitioner's claim for appointment, keeping in view the observations made by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court inAashish Kumar(supra), within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
